content: Joseph ko launuria nongote numi wetang te beteram

Joseph bo karogo numi kaluwurokko me terong mam, se sail te airam ale ko ura kari nunga maonam, “Nina suen la aratalko!” mam. Se kariimet bo kigilik mena, am mu kota ko launuria arungak, asele nu numi wetang saparam.
Ale sail te niakaso, se Egypt kariimet ko niara mu ikiman. Se Pharaoh ko nuwus kuriang se suen la nirung umu ko den ikiman tala.
Joseph ko launuria nunga maonam, “Ani Joseph i!” mam. “Aga ait kueram agi am bagoso e?” mam. Bare ko launari nu kuring te me basukasan, mu awuk, nuna noko koma motam ko nguangakasan.

Joseph akingtala nunga maonam, “Aningate pingi tairalko,” mam. Se nuna kote pingi namaman, se balam, “Ani nenenga uria Joseph i. Nina ani Ishmael alo nuguting te aga beteman, ale manga taman, se nuna ani agarak Egypt taiman borta.

Bare aitak nina uwuta aga beteman mu ko, me ninimi nengemang maguwural ale dolaral nguangaralko. Mu awuk, Kaem ani te kariimet nunga sanguk se me kua parangamonko lage beteram se ani girem imi te tairem.
Karak biya sor imi iram mu aitak ko yia ilagala aram. Ale ningam aguwa ale gi nana ko munan mu betela, yia tom 5 nangama ko taiwasan mu ningi me anirukko tala.
Buta se Kaem aninga giruwuram se tairem, nina ninga sangik se ninga kuriang gue ali imi te me mena namamonko. Imi kiwem aora bo beteram.

“Bore te se, nina ani imi te aga beteman se me tairem, mena. Kaem kota aninga beteram se imi te tairem. Nu ani Pharaoh ko wosagam kitira ko kari gira ko aga beteram. Ale Pharaoh ko imet kuriang kawam digo lilim, se Egypt sor lilim ko governor ko aga beteram.

Ario, nina tairate aga ba kote peleral namaral ale iwita maonalko: Ka namar Joseph iwita balam, Kaem Joseph Egypt sor lilim ko governor ko beteram se bagoso ma balalko. Ale pasak ala kote nama kaparko ko balam malko.
Ni namar nu kumik duap te, koma Goshen masan mu te, ka kuriang nimasari, ka bulmakau, sipsip, se ka melmasak suen la karogo umu te kuwim toko mam.

Ani pingi mu te inang te ninga sinar taikko, mu awuk, karak biya imi yia tom 5 nangama ko taiwoso mu am nanga iluwuruk se, ni se ka kuriang gue lilim, se ka melmasak lilim ago paranga namaral bore ko,” mam.
“Nina ta ani agarkaman uwutatala, aga uria Benjamin agarkam, mu nunguningta anigita nengerak munakawasam.
Egypt alo nup biya ani aisisan mu se, melmasak suen la nina arigiman mu aga ait maonal se ikiokko. Se pasak ala ilak imi te tai kaparalko,” mam.
Ale ko uria Benjamin yasaram ale ilak niakaso. Se Benjamin agotala nu iluwam ale niakaso.
Asele nu ko launari suen la nunga yasaram ale nongorak niakaso. Se ko launuria nongomang motam kua kaparam se nu ilak munakakasan.
Tom Pharaoh ko kari supuling suen la karogo Joseph ko launuria kote taiman mu ko den ikiman mu nuna amilmilaman.
Se Pharaoh Joseph maonam, “Ka launuria nunga manaru se melmasak gi donkey te awumon ale pelemon Canaan namamon,
ale nunga nonet se nunga imet kuriang suen la nunga gimon ale arungak aningate taimonko. Se ani Egypt ali koma bo ningo mu nungarik se, nuna ali bilik mu ko ningo nuam te to no se bagamonko.
“Ni nunga manaru se iwita betemonko: ana Egypt nanga karis saki nongorak namamon ale nunga imet kuriang se nunga nonet te nongorak taimonko.
Nunga biung kako ko ikia me tamonko, mu awuk, Egypt ko mel ningo ningo mu nononga arukko.”
Se Israel ko namarari butata beteman. Joseph Pharaoh balam butata karis sang nungaram, ale na sang lage te namonko mu ago nungaram.
Ale suan suan guang iru iru nagumonko mu nungaram. Bare Benjamin mu manga silver 300 se guang iru motam 5 karogo tuam.
Ale nuet ko mu melmasak imi awuram: donkey 10 Egypt ko mel ningo ningo karogo terong mam, se donkey imet 10 tala mu na inang se melmasak saki lage te no se tairukko mu ago terong mam.
Asele ko launuria nunga beteram se namakasan, se nunga maonam, “Lage luan te ninimi karogo me kaeralko!” mam.
Se nuna Egypt beteman ale nunga nonet kote Canaan sor te nama tarigiman.
Ale manorman, “Joseph marak bagoso! Ale nu Egypt sor lilim bitaruwoso,” maman. Bare Jacob den umu ikiam mu nu tingam ale kuring menaram.
Se nuna Joseph den suen biya nunga maonam mu manorman. Se karis, nu te gimon ale ilak pelemon namamonko beteram mu arigam, asele noman biyala saparam.
Ale balam, “Aitak asele ani angamang ningi nunguning aram. Aninga namar Joseph am marak bagoso! Ani amotam me kuinisam la, pasak namarik ale arigekko,” mam.

footnotes.text: Joseph ko den sang Acts 7:6-16 mu te aniso.
